No. e  and Registrar's  order with  Signatures  WPCRL No.1606 of 2025  Hon'ble Ashish Naithani, J.
Ms. Divya Jain, learned counsel for the Petitioner.
2. Mr. G.C. Joshi, learned AGA, for the State of Uttarakhand/1 to 3.

3. Mr. Abhijay Negi, learned counsel for the Respondent No.4.
4.

The present writ petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India filed by the Petitioner for quashing/setting- aside the FIR No.77 of 2024, under Sections 323, 420, 506, 467, 468, 471 and 120-B of IPC, at Police Station Rajpur, District Dehradun and directing the Respondent nos.1 to 3 not to arrest the Petitioner in connection with the abovementioned F.I.R.
5. Heard.
6.

7. Counter affidavit, if any, to be filed by the Respondents within a period of three weeks.
8.

9. In the interregnum, it is directed that the investigation shall proceed but the present Petitioner shall not be arrested by the Police in pursuance to FIR No.77 of 2024, under Sections 323, 420, 506,
467, 468, 471 and 120-B of IPC, at Police Station Rajpur, District Dehradun.

However, he will continue to cooperate with the Investigating Officer of the case and shall remain present before the Investigating Officer, as and when required for production of documents and for recording of his statements.
10. Stay applications (IA No.1 of 2025) stands disposed of accordingly.

(Ashish Naithani, J.) 04.12.2025 Nitesh/
